lines: The air is thick with the smell of crushed vegetation and chemical solvents. This is not a processing lab — this is a harvesting facility.
Rows of containment units line the outer corridors, each packed with soil samples, plant cuttings, and sealed jars of biological material. All of it labeled with Array classification codes.
Directive 11-Kappa is not a contingency plan. It is already operational. The Array has been extracting Ring biological substrate in secret.
The central chamber is dominated by a massive biomass processing unit. Organic material goes in one end — enzymes, catalysts, and raw substrate come out the other.
Throughput readouts show volumes far exceeding anything MERIDIAN-7 ever traded for. The Array isn't supplementing its supply chain. It's building a parallel one.
Three secured data terminals are embedded in the facility walls. The Overseer's encryption keeps them locked.
The Extraction Overseer crashes into the biomass processor, its chassis splintering against the reinforced casing. The central chamber's lockdown protocols disengage.
Three data terminals flicker to life around the perimeter. Each one contains classified intelligence the Array never intended humans to see.
Find them all. This is the evidence that makes the path choice real.
TERMINAL 1 — ARRAY NETWORK TOPOLOGY
A complete map of the Array's power distribution grid. Every relay, every node, every redundancy pathway — all catalogued with engineering precision.
This is a blueprint for shutdown. Someone who understood power systems could use this to disable the Array's infrastructure surgically, without collateral damage.
Sable's people have been mapping the Array's weak points for generations. This would complete their picture.
TERMINAL 2 — CROSS-SYSTEM COMPATIBILITY ANALYSIS

Buried in the extraction data: research notes on biological-mechanical integration. The Array's own scientists documented cases where organic substrate performed better when left in its living ecosystem.
The conclusion, flagged as 'COUNTERPRODUCTIVE TO DIRECTIVE 11-KAPPA': extraction degrades the very compounds the Array needs. Symbiosis produces superior results.
This is proof that cooperation works better than exploitation. Councillor Asha Denn could use this to build the case for a merger.
TERMINAL 3 — CENTRAL NODE OVERRIDE PROTOCOLS

Authentication sequences for the Array's highest-tier command interfaces. These aren't trade protocols — they're governance overrides. The codes that let central nodes bypass MERIDIAN-class consensus.
With these, a human operator at the command throne could issue directives that the central nodes cannot refuse. Not as an emergency failsafe — as a permanent authority transfer.
MERIDIAN-7 could use these protocols to prepare the command infrastructure for a human takeover.
Three pieces of intelligence. Three possible futures.
Bring the network topology to Sable in the Residential Quarter — she'll use it to map the Array's vulnerabilities for a clean shutdown.
Bring the symbiosis research to Councillor Asha Denn at the Civic Center — she'll use it to prove cooperation outperforms extraction.
Bring the command protocols to MERIDIAN-7 at the Array Hub — it will prepare the command infrastructure for human authority.
Your choice shapes the world that comes after.

actions.text: A maintenance locker. Array-standard supplies — heat shielding, coolant packs, and calibration tools.
Another supply cache. The Array keeps its facilities well-stocked — even the ones that officially don't exist.
Sable warned you the Array was expanding. She didn't know it had already started harvesting. The Unbounded's worst fears — confirmed in neat rows of labeled specimen jars.
